Head_and_Face: Head is broad with prominent sagittal crest in males.
External ear pinnae (visible ear flaps) distinguish from true seals.
Whiskers (vibrissae) are prominent and sensitive.
Body_and_Plumage: Fur is short and coarse ranging from brown to dark grey, lighter on ventral surface.
Body exhibits streamlined fusiform form of substantial marine mammal proportions.
Males develop thick neck mane and are significantly larger than females.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Foreflippers are large, broad, and hairless on underside used for terrestrial locomotion.
Hind flippers can rotate forward for walking on land.
Body exhibits bilateral symmetry.

Head_and_Face: Head is distinctive apple-domed (rounded skull) with prominent protruding eyes.
Muzzle is short and pointed.
Large erect ears set wide apart.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat varieties include smooth (short, glossy, close-lying) and long (soft, fine, slightly wavy).
Coloration ranges from solid fawn, black, white, chocolate, cream to parti-color and merle.
Body is compact and slightly longer than tall, of diminutive toy-dog proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are slender and straight.
Tail is moderately long, carried in sickle curve over back.
Expression is alert and terrier-like.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and domed with large round dark eyes set wide apart.
Muzzle is very short and broad.
Ears are small, triangular, heavily feathered, and set wide on head.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is long, silky, straight, and profuse, lying flat against body.
Coloration is black-and-white or red-and-white with white body and colored patches on head, ears, and tail base.
White blaze runs up face between eyes.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are feathered and fine-boned.
Tail is heavily plumed and carried curled over back.
Gait is stylish and animated.

Head_and_Face: Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop.
Eyes are large, round, and dark brown with black eye rims.
Nose is jet black.
Body_and_Plumage: Long, straight, silky white coat hangs to the ground when untrimmed, lacking undercoat.
Hair texture is fine and glossy resembling human hair.
Entire coat should be pure white; light tan or lemon on ears is permissible.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and fine-boned with black paw pads.
Tail is plumed and carried curved over back.
Gait is smooth and flowing.

Head_and_Face: Broad flat muzzle and wrinkled face creating lion-like expression.
Eyes are large, round, dark, and prominent.
Ears are heart-shaped, heavily feathered, and carried close to head.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is long, straight, and profuse with coarse outer coat and soft undercoat forming mane around neck.
Coloration includes all colors: gold, red, black, white, cream, parti-color.
Body is compact, heavy for size, with thick chest of diminutive toy-dog proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short, thick, and bowed.
Tail is heavily plumed and carried curved over back.
Rolled gait characteristic of breed.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and round with short square muzzle and undershot bite.
Eyes are large, round, dark, and widely spaced.
Ears are large, drop, heavily feathered, and blend into neck coat.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is long, dense, flowing, and double-layered with profuse undercoat.
Hair falls straight down both sides of body parting along spine.
Coloration is variable: gold, white, black, liver, brindle, or parti-color.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short and sturdy.
Tail is heavily plumed and carried curled over back in chrysanthemum pattern.
Gait is smooth and arrogant.

Head_and_Face: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
Body_and_Plumage: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
Gait is free and active.

Head_and_Face: Large erect butterfly-like ears with long fringing hair (papillon = butterfly).
Head is small and slightly rounded with fine muzzle and definite stop.
Eyes are dark, round, and alert.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is long, silky, straight, and abundant, lying flat on body.
Coloration is white with patches of any color except liver: black, red, sable, lemon.
Body is fine-boned, elegant, and slightly longer than tall, of small toy-spaniel proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are fine and straight.
Tail is long, plumed, and arched over back.
Gait is quick, graceful, and effortless.

Head_and_Face: Head is elongated and flat with small V-shaped ears that may be erect or semi-erect.
Eyes are small, dark, and alert with keen expression.
Muzzle is moderately long and pointed.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, smooth, glossy, and close-lying.
Coloration is typically black-and-tan with rich mahogany markings on muzzle, chest, legs, and ventral surface.
Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall, of diminutive toy-dog proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and fine-boned but muscular.
Tail is set high and carried gaily.
Gait is free and active with good reach.

Head_and_Face: Head is fairly long and flat with moderate stop.
Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat.
Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head.
Body_and_Plumage: Ridge of reversed hair growing forward along spine from shoulders to hips forming two symmetrical crowns.
Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten.
Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest of large hound proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular.
Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve.
Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
